newsitem.title: USA: TRW completes purchase of Magna companies.
newsitem.headline: TRW completes purchase of Magna companies.

text.p: TRW Inc said Wednesday it has completed its purchase of an 80 percent equity interest in two automotive firms owned by Magna International Inc.

The acquired operations include MST Automotive GmbH Automobil-Sicherheitstechnik, a European supplier of air bag modules, steering wheels, and other related automotive components; and Temic Bayern-Chemie Airbag GmbH, a European supplier of air bag inflators and propellants and related automotive components.
As part of an alliance announced by TRW and Magna in December, the companies will operate a joint technical center that will focus on vehicle safety systems integration.
